title: Compound Angle Formulas
text:
The compound angle formulas are:
- $$\cos(A + B) = \cos A \cos B - \sin A \sin B$$
- $$\cos(A - B) = \cos A \cos B + \sin A \sin B$$
- $$\sin(A + B) = \sin A \cos B + \cos A \sin B$$
- $$\sin(A - B) = \sin A \cos B - \cos A \sin B$$

title: Matching the Pattern
text:
We have cos(90° - x), which is in the form cos(A - B).

Therefore, we use: $$\cos(A - B) = \cos A \cos B + \sin A \sin B$$

hintAnswer: cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B
title: Confirm Formula
text: The cosine subtraction formula has a PLUS sign between terms (opposite to addition formula).
